name: revelator
summary: my institutional capstone: a web and mobile-capable document screening app for CCJE personnel at LSPU San Pablo. react meets fastapi, authenticated accounts, scan history, and gemini-assisted image analysis for human review.
problem: Support document screening for CCJE personnel at LSPU San Pablo with an application that brings image submission, assisted analysis, and review history together.
highlights: Document screening: Submit document images for Gemini-assisted analysis, with the result supporting a person's review.
Accounts & history: Authenticated access and stored scan history keep document screening organized across sessions.
Web & mobile foundation: A React interface built with Vite and Capacitor supports a shared application foundation for browser and mobile use.

media.caption: Authentication screen in the running Revelator frontend; no account data is shown.
Account-registration form before entering any personal information.

sections.heading: The workflow
sections.body:
- Sign in to an account.
- Submit a document image for screening.
- Review the assisted analysis.
- Return to previous scans through the stored history.

sections.heading: Under the hood
sections.body: React/Vite provides the interface, while FastAPI handles backend requests. SQLAlchemy and SQLite support persistence, and Gemini supplies the image-analysis integration.

sections.heading: Scope & current state
sections.body: An institutional capstone and screening aid. Analysis is intended for human review and does not establish document authenticity by itself.
